Author: HeartOfFlowers

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/44028/44028-1780094913-1790569721.png[/img][/center]
[b]- Now compatible with AhCuteArt's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45929]Seasonal Cute[/url] Nyapu's retextures!
[/b][b]- Now we have a bunch more sprites for Slightly cuter aesthetic![/b]
[b]
Sweet Visuals [/b]is a mod that adds new vanilla-like portraits for many of the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]'s characters! Below you can see every character that this mod covers, however, [b]we will add more[/b] with time! Here's a list of characters that are compatible;

[list]
[*][b]The entire Hart family, Edith, Ethan, Michael and Stella[/b][/*]
[*]Aideen [/*]
[*]Beatrice[/*]
[*]Eloise[/*]
[*]Eyvinder [/*]
[*]Jade[/*]
[*]Jasper [/*]
[*]Jessie[/*]
[*]Juliet[/*]
[*]Keanu[/*]
[*]Lexi [/*]
[*]Tori[/*]
[*]Vivienne[/*]
[*]Optionally, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18176]Nora the Herpetologist[/url] if installed![/*]
[*]More characters to come! (Including add-ons)[/*]
[/list][center][b][i][font=Courier New][size=5]Spring[/size][/font][/i][/b][/center]

[left][center][b][size=5][font=Courier New][i]Compatibility[/i][/font]: [/size][/b][/center]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450][/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16045]Seasonal Cute Characters[/url] is 100% compatible[/b]. If installed, Sweet Visuals' portraits will replace existing SCC portraits, and SCC's seasonal outfits will take priority over Sweet Visuals'. This means you'll be able to see the outfits in our portraits![/left]
[left][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39307]Lexi of the Lagoon[/url] is compatible with our mod if you're looking for more options for Lexi!
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's portraits [/url]are[b] compatible! Please install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45929]Seasonal Cute Nyapu retextures![/url] [/b]
[b]Other portrait and/or sprite replacements for East Scarp were not tested and are likely to cause inconsistencies and issues.[/b][/left]
[center][font=Courier New]
[i][b][size=5]Future plans![/size][/b]
[/i][/font]
[left]While this mod is [b]complete[/b] and adds many portraits, we [b]plan to include even more characters! [/b]Here's the list:
[list]
[*]Many other characters from East Scarp, especially the ones included in the Remastered update![/*]
[*]All the critters like Gremlin, the emperor, all the cats and more![/*]
[*]With permission of the authors, we might add compatibility with add-ons.[/*]
[*]Adding extra seasonal outfits! (Romanceable candidates take priority)[/*]
[*]Adding festival outfits for those who are missing them![/*]
[/list][/left]

[b][size=5][font=Courier New][i]Extra[/i][/font][/size][/b]

[left]If you want to make your outfits compatible with our mod please contact me! (HeartOfFlowers)
This mod was entirely [b]human made[/b], no AI was used in the creation of the assets or media content.
[b]We do not allow our art or any part of this mod to be used in Generative AI training.[/b][/left]
[left][/left]
